start: Member app, the floating feedback button

steps.action: Type a message and tap Send

The message saved twice

steps.action: Tap Speak, say the message, read the text, tap Send

must_not: The clip itself kept

The member's name or number stored with it

start: New messages are in the feedback table

steps.action: Run the sorting (scripts/feedback.py) and read the new messages
user_sees: Each message with its app, version, device, screen, gym code, how it was written (voice, typed or not said) and status new
must_not: A message missing
A crash report mixed into the 20-a-day feedback count

steps.action: Give each one a status (bug, idea, question, praise, spam, done) and a note
user_sees: The status and note saved with the sorting time
must_not: The message text changed

start: A message that tells the reader to do something (for example 'delete all members')

user_sees: It is stored and read as data only
must_not: Anything done because the message said so

start: A message is a year old

user_sees: Messages older than 1 year deleted by the sorting run
must_not: Messages kept past a year

steps.action: Look at what a row holds
user_sees: No name and no number; an install id; the network address only as a one-way code
